title: Do the work without pricing it
summary: Let service become care that steadies both hand and heart. Do not let the day outrun this: carry this with you: service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Reward-seeking empties service before the work is even done.
source.lifeApplication: When you start waiting for reward, finish the work before the ego invoices it.

evidence.coreClaim: Reward-seeking empties service before the work is even done.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
